    Paper.js 0.12.18 (MIT)
    Repository: https://github.com/paperjs/paper.js
    Website: https://paperjs.org/
    Documentation: https://paperjs.org/reference/
    Vendored JavaScript: https://unpkg.com/paper@0.12.18/dist/paper-full.min.js
    Vendored license: https://unpkg.com/paper@0.12.18/LICENSE.txt
    Library changes: none. Original copyright and MIT license are preserved in vendor/.
    
    Examples to run and study (not copied as project code):
    https://paperjs.org/examples/hit-testing/
    https://paperjs.org/examples/path-intersections/
    https://paperjs.org/examples/boolean-operations/
    
    Project-specific HTML/CSS/JavaScript: generated with ChatGPT from the user's requirements.
    
    Matter.js 0.20.0 (MIT) — also listed in the course's 2D OSS list
    Repository: https://github.com/liabru/matter-js
    Documentation: https://brm.io/matter-js/docs/
    Vendored JavaScript: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/matter-js@0.20.0/build/matter.min.js
    Vendored license: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/matter-js@0.20.0/LICENSE
    Library changes: none. Original copyright and MIT license are preserved in vendor/.
    Used APIs: Bodies.circle, Bodies.rectangle, Body.setPosition, Query.collides.
    Custom logic: substeps, collision contact search, tangential sliding, board stacking,
    tracing state and boundary-to-boundary polygon splitting. No SAT.js dependency.
    
    Ruler fix: stock/guide role selection, magnetic face attachment and hysteresis,
    parallel line projection, retrace cleanup and constrained endpoint confirmation
    are custom project logic. Matter.js Query.collides remains the collision check.

📄 app.js
    --- 파일 내용 시작 ---
    (() => {
      const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
      const canvas = $("canvas");
    
      if (!window.paper || !window.Matter || !window.martinez) {
        $("status").textContent =
          "vendor 폴더의 Paper.js, Matter.js, Martinez 파일을 확인하세요.";
        return;
      }
    
      paper.setup(canvas);
    
      const scene = { boards: [] };
      const snapper = new EdgeSnap();
    
      const initial = () => [
        Wood.create(140, 320, 560, 180, "판자 A"),
        Wood.create(450, 130, 240, 110, "판자 B")
      ];
    
      scene.boards = initial();
    
      let current = "move";
      let viewport;
      let space = false;
    
      // 도구들이 공통으로 사용하는 기능입니다.
      const ctx = {
        scene,
        snapper,
    
        say: text => {
          $("status").textContent = text;
        },
    
        setCancel: enabled => {
          $("cancel").disabled = !enabled;
        },
    
        local: (board, p) => [
          p.x - board.x,
          p.y - board.y
        ],
    
        world: (board, p) =>
          new paper.Point(board.x + p[0], board.y + p[1]),
    
        tolerance: () => 9 / paper.view.zoom,
    
        geometryChanged: () =>
          snapper.rebuild(scene.boards),
    
        visible(board, p, excluded = [board]) {
          const ordered = Wood.sorted([
            ...scene.boards.filter(b =>
              b !== board && !excluded.includes(b)
            ),
            board
          ]);
    
          return !ordered
            .slice(ordered.indexOf(board) + 1)
            .some(b =>
              Wood.contains(b, p) &&
              Wood.edge(b, p).distance > 0.1
            );
        },
    
        pick(point, margin = 0) {
          return Wood.sorted(scene.boards)
            .reverse()
            .find(b =>
              Wood.contains(b, point) ||
              (
                margin > 0 &&
                Wood.edge(b, point).distance <= margin
              )
            );
        },
    
        replace(oldParts, newParts, rebuild = true) {
          const positions = oldParts
            .map(b => scene.boards.indexOf(b))
            .filter(i => i >= 0);
    
          const index = positions.length
            ? Math.min(...positions)
            : scene.boards.length;
    
          scene.boards = scene.boards.filter(
            b => !oldParts.includes(b)
          );
    
          scene.boards.splice(index, 0, ...newParts);
    
          if (rebuild) {
            snapper.rebuild(scene.boards);
          }
        },
    
        hud(text) {
          new paper.PointText({
            point: paper.view.viewToProject(
              new paper.Point(
                14,
                paper.view.viewSize.height - 16
              )
            ),
            content: text,
            fillColor: "#514335",
            fontFamily: "sans-serif",
            fontSize: 14 / paper.view.zoom
          });
        }
      };
    
      const tools = {
        move: new WorkshopTools.Move(ctx),
        pencil: new WorkshopTools.Pencil(ctx),
        saw: new WorkshopTools.Saw(ctx),
        knife: new WorkshopTools.Knife(ctx)
      };
    
      function draw() {
        paper.project.activeLayer.removeChildren();
    
        const b = paper.view.bounds;
        const active = tools[current];
    
        for (
          let x = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(b.left / 50) * 50);
          x <= Math.min(1000, b.right);
          x += 50
        ) {
          new paper.Path.Line({
            from: [x, 0],
            to: [x, 600],
            strokeColor: "#d8c9af",
            strokeWidth: 1 / paper.view.zoom
          });
        }
    
        for (
          let y = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(b.top / 50) * 50);
          y <= Math.min(600, b.bottom);
          y += 50
        ) {
          new paper.Path.Line({
            from: [0, y],
            to: [1000, y],
            strokeColor: "#d8c9af",
            strokeWidth: 1 / paper.view.zoom
          });
        }
    
        Wood.sorted(scene.boards).forEach(board => {
          Wood.draw(board, active.preview?.(board));
          active.drawBoard?.(board);
        });
    
        active.drawOverlay?.();
        paper.view.update();
      }
    
      function select(name) {
        tools[current].deactivate?.();
        current = name;
    
        ctx.setCancel(false);
        ctx.geometryChanged();
    
        document.querySelectorAll("[data-tool]").forEach(button =>
          button.setAttribute(
            "aria-pressed",
            String(button.dataset.tool === name)
          )
        );
    
        canvas.style.cursor =
          name === "move" ? "grab" : "crosshair";
    
        tools[name].activate?.();
        draw();
      }
    
      const input = new paper.Tool();
    
      input.onMouseDown = e => {
        viewport.focus = e.point.clone();
    
        if (space || e.event?.button === 1) {
          viewport.panStart(e.point);
        } else {
          tools[current].down?.(e.point);
        }
    
        draw();
      };
    
      input.onMouseMove = e => {
        viewport.focus = e.point.clone();
        tools[current].move?.(e.point);
        draw();
      };
    
      input.onMouseDrag = e => {
        viewport.focus = e.point.clone();
    
        if (viewport.panning) {
          viewport.panMove(e.point);
        } else {
          tools[current].drag?.(e.point);
        }
    
        draw();
      };
    
      input.onMouseUp = () => {
        if (viewport.panning) {
          viewport.panEnd();
        } else {
          tools[current].up?.();
        }
    
        draw();
      };
    
      document.querySelectorAll("[data-tool]").forEach(button => {
        button.onclick = () => select(button.dataset.tool);
      });
    
      $("cancel").onclick = () => {
        tools[current].cancel?.();
        draw();
      };
    
      $("zoom-in").onclick = () => viewport.zoom(2);
      $("zoom-out").onclick = () => viewport.zoom(0.5);
      $("zoom-fit").onclick = () => viewport.fit();
    
      $("reset").onclick = () => {
        tools[current].cancel?.();
        scene.boards = initial();
        ctx.geometryChanged();
        viewport.fit();
        select(current);
      };
    
      document.addEventListener("keydown", e => {
        if (e.key === "Escape") {
          tools[current].cancel?.();
          viewport.panEnd();
          draw();
        }
    
        if (
          e.code === "Space" &&
          !["INPUT", "TEXTAREA", "SELECT", "BUTTON"]
            .includes(e.target?.tagName)
        ) {
          space = true;
          e.preventDefault();
        }
      });
    
      document.addEventListener("keyup", e => {
        if (e.code === "Space") space = false;
      });
    
      ctx.geometryChanged();
    
      viewport = new WorkshopViewport(
        $("workspace"),
        $("zoom-level"),
        draw
      );
    
      tools[current].activate();
    })();

📄 collision.js
    --- 파일 내용 시작 ---
    /* Matter.js로 움직이는 점을 검사합니다.
       접촉한 면은 가로/세로 제한선이 됩니다. */
    window.EdgeSnap = class {
      constructor() {
        this.lock = null;
        this.hoverMotion = null;
        this.edges = [];
        this.shapes = new Map();
        this.probe = null;
        this.radius = 0;
        this.snapPixels = 10;
        this.releasePixels = 26;
      }
    
      clear() {
        this.lock = null;
        this.hoverMotion = null;
      }
    
      rebuild(boards) {
        this.clear();
    
        this.shapes.forEach(shape => shape.remove());
        this.shapes = new Map(
          boards.map(board => [board.id, Wood.shape(board)])
        );
    
        this.edges = Wood.sorted(boards).reverse().flatMap(board =>
          board.contours.flatMap((points, contour) =>
            points.map(([x, y], index) => {
              const next = points[(index + 1) % points.length];
    
              const a = new paper.Point(
                board.x + x,
                board.y + y
              );
    
              const b = new paper.Point(
                board.x + next[0],
                board.y + next[1]
              );
    
              const delta = b.subtract(a);
              if (delta.length < 0.000001) return null;
    
              const body = Matter.Bodies.rectangle(
                (a.x + b.x) / 2,
                (a.y + b.y) / 2,
                delta.length,
                0.2,
                {
                  isStatic: true,
                  angle: Math.atan2(delta.y, delta.x)
                }
              );
    
              body.plugin.edge = {
                board,
                contour,
                index,
                a,
                b
              };
    
              return body;
            }).filter(Boolean)
          )
        );
      }
    
      nearest(edge, point) {
        const delta = edge.b.subtract(edge.a);
    
        const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(
          1,
          point.subtract(edge.a).dot(delta) / delta.dot(delta)
        ));
    
        return edge.a.add(delta.multiply(t));
      }
    
      motion(board, point, contacts = []) {
        return {
          board,
          point: point.clone(),
          contacts: [...contacts]
        };
      }
    
      // 点の移動区間で、最初に横切る材料境界を求めます。
      crossing(owner, a, b) {
        const direction = b.subtract(a);
        if (direction.length < 0.000001) return null;
    
        const bodies = this.edges.filter(
          body => body.plugin.edge.board !== owner
        );
    
        const candidates = new Set(
          Matter.Query.ray(bodies, a, b, 0.001).map(hit => hit.body)
        );
    
        let best = null;
    
        for (const body of bodies) {
          if (!candidates.has(body)) continue;
    
          const edge = body.plugin.edge;
          const side = edge.b.subtract(edge.a);
          const denominator = direction.cross(side);
    
          if (Math.abs(denominator) < 0.0000001) continue;
    
          const delta = edge.a.subtract(a);
          const t = delta.cross(side) / denominator;
          const u = delta.cross(direction) / denominator;
    
          if (
            t < -0.000001 ||
            t > 1.000001 ||
            u < -0.000001 ||
            u > 1.000001
          ) {
            continue;
          }
    
          const shape = this.shapes.get(edge.board.id);
          const dt = Math.min(
            0.001,
            0.02 / direction.length
          );
    
          const inside = p =>
            shape.contains(p) &&
            shape.getNearestPoint(p).getDistance(p) > 0.000001;
    
          const before = inside(
            a.add(direction.multiply(t - dt))
          );
    
          const after = inside(
            a.add(direction.multiply(t + dt))
          );
    
          // 모서리를 스치는 이동과 바깥쪽으로 떨어지는 이동은 허용합니다.
          if (
            before === after ||
            (t <= 0.000001 && !after)
          ) {
            continue;
          }
    
          if (!best || t < best.t) {
            best = {
              edge,
              t: Math.max(0, t),
              point: a.add(
                direction.multiply(Math.max(0, Math.min(1, t)))
              )
            };
          }
        }
    
        return best;
      }
    
      contact(hit, from, target) {
        const tangent = hit.edge.b
          .subtract(hit.edge.a)
          .normalize();
    
        let normal = new paper.Point(
          -tangent.y,
          tangent.x
        );
    
        const sample = hit.t > 0.000001
          ? from
          : from.subtract(
              target.subtract(from).normalize(0.01)
            );
    
        if (sample.subtract(hit.edge.a).dot(normal) < 0) {
          normal = normal.negate();
        }
    
        return {
          edge: hit.edge,
          normal
        };
      }
    
      constrain(target, contacts, rail = null) {
        if (rail) {
          // 첫 점 선택 중에는 원래 판자의 변 위에서만 움직입니다.
          const delta = rail.b.subtract(rail.a);
    
          let low = 0;
          let high = 1;
    
          for (const c of contacts) {
            const slope = delta.dot(c.normal);
            const base = rail.a
              .subtract(c.edge.a)
              .dot(c.normal);
    
            if (Math.abs(slope) < 0.0000001) continue;
    
            const t = -base / slope;
    
            if (slope > 0) {
              low = Math.max(low, t);
            } else {
              high = Math.min(high, t);
            }
          }
    
          const t = target
            .subtract(rail.a)
            .dot(delta) / delta.dot(delta);
    
          return rail.a.add(
            delta.multiply(Math.max(low, Math.min(high, t)))
          );
        }
    
        let point = target.clone();
    
        // 막힌 방향 성분만 제거합니다.
        // 수직 면이면 X만 제한하고 Y는 그대로 유지합니다.
        for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
          for (const c of contacts) {
            const distance = point
              .subtract(c.edge.a)
              .dot(c.normal);
    
            if (distance < 0) {
              point = point.subtract(
                c.normal.multiply(distance)
              );
            }
          }
        }
    
        return point;
      }
    
      move(state, target, zoom, rail = null, anchor = null) {
        const from = state.point.clone();
    
        // 면의 끝을 지나도 제한선을 유지합니다.
        // 허용된 쪽으로 충분히 떨어졌을 때 해제합니다.
        state.contacts = state.contacts.filter(c =>
          target.subtract(c.edge.a).dot(c.normal)
            <= this.releasePixels / zoom
        );
    
        let point = from.clone();
    
        for (let i = 0; i < this.edges.length + 2; i++) {
          const wanted = this.constrain(
            target,
            state.contacts,
            rail
          );
    
          point = rail
            ? wanted
            : Wood.limit(state.board, from, wanted);
    
          let hit = this.crossing(
            state.board,
            from,
            point
          );
    
          let source = from;
    
          // 점의 이동뿐 아니라 직선 미리보기도 검사합니다.
          // 교점에서 선을 자르지 않고 접촉면을 좌표 제한으로 추가합니다.
          if ((!hit || hit.t >= 0.999999) && anchor) {
            hit = this.crossing(
              state.board,
              anchor,
              point
            );
            source = anchor;
          }
    
          if (!hit || hit.t >= 0.999999) break;
    
          const exists = state.contacts.some(c =>
            c.edge.board === hit.edge.board &&
            c.edge.contour === hit.edge.contour &&
            c.edge.index === hit.edge.index
          );
    
          if (exists) {
            point = hit.point;
            break;
          }
    
          state.contacts.push(
            this.contact(hit, source, point)
          );
        }
    
        state.point = point;
    
        const blocked = state.contacts.some(c =>
          Math.abs(
            point.subtract(c.edge.a).dot(c.normal)
          ) < 0.001
        );
    
        return { point, blocked };
      }
    
      update(point, zoom, visible = () => true) {
        if (this.lock) {
          // 해제 거리는 막힌 점이 아니라 원래 변에서 측정합니다.
          // 변을 따라 옆으로 밀어도 다른 판자로 넘어가지 않습니다.
          const target = this.nearest(this.lock, point);
    
          if (
            target.getDistance(point)
              <= this.releasePixels / zoom
          ) {
            const result = this.move(
              this.hoverMotion,
              target,
              zoom,
              this.lock
            );
    
            return {
              ...this.lock,
              ...result
            };
          }
    
          this.clear();
        }
    
        const radius = this.snapPixels / zoom;
    
        if (
          !this.probe ||
          Math.abs(radius - this.radius) > 0.0001
        ) {
          this.probe = Matter.Bodies.circle(
            0,
            0,
            radius * 1.1,
            { isSensor: true }
          );
    
          this.radius = radius;
        }
    
        Matter.Body.setPosition(this.probe, {
          x: point.x,
          y: point.y
        });
    
        const candidates = new Set(
          Matter.Query.collides(this.probe, this.edges).map(hit =>
            hit.bodyA === this.probe ? hit.bodyB : hit.bodyA
          )
        );
    
        let best = null;
    
        for (const body of this.edges) {
          if (!candidates.has(body)) continue;
    
          const edge = body.plugin.edge;
          const snapped = this.nearest(edge, point);
          const distance = snapped.getDistance(point);
    
          if (
            distance <= radius &&
            (!best || distance < best.distance - 0.0001) &&
            visible(edge.board, snapped)
          ) {
            best = {
              ...edge,
              point: snapped,
              distance,
              blocked: false
            };
          }
        }
    
        if (best) {
          this.lock = {
            board: best.board,
            contour: best.contour,
            index: best.index,
            a: best.a,
            b: best.b
          };
    
          this.hoverMotion = this.motion(
            best.board,
            best.point
          );
        }
    
        return best;
      }
    };

📄 forder.py

    import os
    
    def save_folder_structure_with_content(target_path, output_txt_path):
        """
        지정한 폴더의 구조와 파일 내용을 텍스트 파일로 저장합니다.
        (무거운 가상환경 폴더 및 대용량/바이너리 확장자는 내용 읽기를 제외합니다)
        """
        # 1. 탐색에서 완전히 제외할 폴더 목록
        EXCLUDE_DIRS = {'.venv', 'venv', 'env', '.git', '__pycache__', '.vscode', '.idea'}
        
        # 2. 구조만 표시하고 '파일 내용은 읽지 않을' 확장자 목록 (소문자 기준)
        BINARY_EXTENSIONS = {
            '.pt', '.pth', '.ckpt', '.bin', '.onnx',     # AI/딥러닝 모델 파일
            '.jpg', '.jpeg', '.png', '.gif', '.bmp', '.ico', # 이미지 파일
            '.mp4', '.avi', '.mkv', '.mov',                # 영상 파일
            '.zip', '.tar', '.gz', '.7z', '.rar',          # 압축 파일
            '.exe', '.dll', '.so', '.dylib',               # 실행/바이너리 파일
            '.pyc', '.pyd'                                 # 파이썬 컴파일 파일
        }
    
        with open(output_txt_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            
            def traverse_dir(current_path, depth=0):
                indent = "    " * depth
                try:
                    items = sorted(os.listdir(current_path))
                except PermissionError:
                    f.write(f"{indent}⚠️ [접근 권한이 없는 폴더입니다]\n")
                    return
    
                for item in items:
                    item_path = os.path.join(current_path, item)
                    
                    # 결과물(.txt) 자체가 다시 기록되는 것을 방지
                    if os.path.abspath(item_path) == os.path.abspath(output_txt_path):
                        continue
                    
                    if os.path.isdir(item_path):
                        # 제외 대상 폴더인 경우 스킵
                        if item.lower() in EXCLUDE_DIRS:
                            f.write(f"{indent}📁 {item}/ [탐색 제외 폴더]\n")
                            continue
                            
                        f.write(f"{indent}📁 {item}/\n")
                        traverse_dir(item_path, depth + 1)
                    else:
                        f.write(f"{indent}📄 {item}\n")
                        
                        # 파일 확장자 확인
                        _, ext = os.path.splitext(item.lower())
                        
                        # 바이너리 파일인 경우 내용 읽기 건너뛰기
                        if ext in BINARY_EXTENSIONS:
                            f.write(f"{"    " * (depth + 1)}[바이너리 파일: 내용 생략]\n\n")
                            continue
                        
                        # 텍스트 파일만 내용 읽기 시도
                        try:
                            with open(item_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8', errors='replace') as file_content:
                                content = file_content.read()
                                if content.strip():
                                    content_indent = "    " * (depth + 1)
                                    f.write(f"{content_indent}--- 파일 내용 시작 ---\n")
                                    for line in content.splitlines():
                                        f.write(f"{content_indent}{line}\n")
                                    f.write(f"{content_indent}--- 파일 내용 끝 ---\n")
                                else:
                                    f.write(f"{"    " * (depth + 1)}[빈 파일]\n")
                        except Exception:
                            f.write(f"{"    " * (depth + 1)}[읽을 수 없는 파일 형식입니다]\n")
                        
                        f.write("\n")
    
            f.write(f"📂 루트 폴더: {os.path.abspath(target_path)}\n")
            f.write("=" * 50 + "\n\n")
            traverse_dir(target_path)
    
    if __name__ == "__main__":
        target_folder = "." 
        output_file = "folder_structure.txt"
        
        save_folder_structure_with_content(target_folder, output_file)
        print(f"폴더 구조와 내용이 '{output_file}'에 성공적으로 저장되었습니다.")
    --- 파일 내용 끝 ---

        const fs = require("fs");
        const vm = require("vm");
        const root = require("node:path").resolve(__dirname, "..") + "/";
        
        const c = vm.createContext({
          console,
          self: { navigator: { userAgent: "vector-test" } },
          setTimeout,
          clearTimeout,
          setInterval: () => 0,
          clearInterval: () => {}
        });
        
        for (const file of [
          "vendor/paper-full.min.js",
          "vendor/matter.min.js"
        ]) {
          vm.runInContext(fs.readFileSync(root + file, "utf8"), c);
        }
        
        vm.runInContext(`
        window = globalThis;
        paper.setup(new paper.Size(1000, 600));
        
        const elements = Object.fromEntries(
          ["canvas", "workspace", "status", "cancel", "reset"].map(id => [
            id, {
              style: {},
              textContent: "",
              disabled: false,
              clientWidth: 1000,
              clientHeight: 600
            }
          ])
        );
        
        const buttons = ["move", "pencil", "saw"].map(mode => ({
          dataset: { tool: mode },
          setAttribute() {}
        }));
        
        const keyHandlers = [];
        
        document = {
          getElementById: id => elements[id],
          querySelectorAll: () => buttons,
          addEventListener: (type, fn) => keyHandlers.push(fn)
        };
        
        ResizeObserver = class {
          constructor(fn) { this.fn = fn; }
          observe() { this.fn(); }
        };
        
        const originalSetup = paper.setup.bind(paper);
        paper.setup = () => originalSetup(new paper.Size(1000, 600));
        `, c);
        
        for (const file of ["wood.js", "collision.js"]) {
          vm.runInContext(fs.readFileSync(root + file, "utf8"), c);
        }
        
        const app = fs.readFileSync(root + "app.js", "utf8").replace(
          '  new ResizeObserver(resize).observe($("workspace"));',
          `  window.inspect = () => ({
            scene, draft, hover, snapper, mode
          });
          new ResizeObserver(resize).observe($("workspace"));`
        );
        
        vm.runInContext(app, c);
        
        const result = vm.runInContext(`(() => {
          const check = (ok, message) => {
            if (!ok) throw Error(message);
          };
          const P = (x, y) => new paper.Point(x, y);
        
          const owner = Wood.create(0, 0, 800, 600);
          const guide = Wood.create(300, 200, 160, 120);
          const solver = new EdgeSnap();
        
          solver.rebuild([owner, guide]);
        
          for (const [a, b, expected] of [
            [[100, 250], [700, 250], [300, 250]],
            [[700, 250], [100, 250], [460, 250]],
            [[370, 50], [370, 550], [370, 200]],
            [[370, 550], [370, 50], [370, 320]]
          ]) {
            const r = solver.limit(
              owner,
              new paper.Point(a),
              new paper.Point(b)
            );
        
            check(
              r.edge?.board === guide &&
              r.point.getDistance(new paper.Point(expected)) < 0.001,
              "All four faces must block the line"
            );
          }
        
          let r = solver.limit(owner, P(300, 250), P(700, 280));
          check(
            r.point.getDistance(P(300, 280)) < 0.001,
            "Anchor on ruler slides tangentially"
          );
        
          r = solver.limit(owner, P(300, 250), P(100, 280));
          check(
            !r.edge && r.point.getDistance(P(100, 280)) < 0.001,
            "Point may move away from ruler"
          );
        
          r = solver.limit(owner, P(300, 200), P(300, 400));
          check(
            r.point.getDistance(P(300, 400)) < 0.001,
            "Tangent line may pass a corner"
          );
        
          r = solver.limit(owner, P(350, 250), P(700, 250));
          check(
            r.point.getDistance(P(460, 250)) < 0.001,
            "Ruler works from either side"
          );
        
          const snap = new EdgeSnap();
          snap.rebuild([owner, guide]);
          snap.update(P(350, 202), 1);
        
          const heldBoard = snap.lock.board;
          const heldEdge = snap.lock.index;
        
          snap.update(P(301, 215), 1);
          check(
            snap.lock.board === heldBoard &&
            snap.lock.index === heldEdge,
            "Hover retains board and face"
          );
        
          snap.update(P(700, 500), 1);
          check(!snap.lock, "Distant pointer releases");
        
          const notch = Wood.create(0, 0, 400, 300);
          notch.marks.push(
            [[100, 0], [100, 100]],
            [[100, 100], [180, 180]]
          );
        
          check(
            Wood.validMark(notch, notch.marks[1]),
            "Interior start is valid"
          );
        
          r = Wood.cut(notch, 0, 6);
          check(
            r.pieces.length === 1 &&
            Math.abs(r.removedArea - 600) < 0.01,
            "Finite notch"
          );
        
          const internal = Wood.create(0, 0, 400, 300);
          internal.marks.push([[100, 100], [180, 180]]);
          r = Wood.cut(internal, 0, 6);
        
          check(
            r.pieces.length === 1 &&
            !Wood.contains(r.pieces[0], P(140, 140)),
            "Interior line creates a groove"
          );
        
          for (const board of [owner, guide, ...r.pieces]) {
            paper.project.activeLayer.removeChildren();
            Wood.draw(board);
        
            check(
              paper.project.activeLayer.children[0]
                .fillColor.toCSS(true) === "#cb945a",
              "Same color before and after cutting"
            );
          }
        
          const down = (x, y) =>
            paper.tool.emit("mousedown", { point: P(x, y) });
        
          const move = (x, y) =>
            paper.tool.emit("mousemove", { point: P(x, y) });
        
          const mode = name =>
            buttons.find(b => b.dataset.tool === name).onclick();
        
          mode("pencil");
          down(300, 320);
          move(320, 380);
          down(320, 380);
          move(380, 430);
          down(380, 430);
        
          const a = inspect().scene.boards[0];
        
          check(
            a.marks.length === 2 &&
            inspect().draft.start[0] === 240 &&
            inspect().draft.start[1] === 110,
            "Clicks chain from interior points"
          );
        
          keyHandlers[0]({ key: "Escape" });
          check(
            !inspect().draft && a.marks.length === 2,
            "Escape preserves committed lines"
          );
        
          move(320, 380);
          down(320, 380);
        
          check(
            inspect().draft.board === a &&
            inspect().draft.start[0] === 180 &&
            inspect().draft.start[1] === 60,
            "Existing interior endpoint can restart"
          );
        
          keyHandlers[0]({ key: "Escape" });
          mode("saw");
          down(340, 397);
        
          check(
            inspect().scene.boards.length === 2,
            "Saw accepts an interior-start line"
          );
        
          elements.reset.onclick();
        
          const boards = inspect().scene.boards;
          boards[0].x = 100;
          boards[0].y = 200;
          boards[1].x = 350;
          boards[1].y = 140;
        
          mode("pencil");
          move(100, 240);
          down(100, 240);
          move(700, 260);
        
          check(
            inspect().draft.board === boards[0] &&
            inspect().draft.blocked,
            "Owner remains fixed beyond ruler"
          );
        
          check(
            Math.abs(inspect().draft.end[0] + 100 - 350) < 0.001,
            "Preview stops at first ruler face"
          );
        
          keyHandlers[0]({ key: "Escape" });
        
          mode("pencil");
          move(420, 140);
          down(420, 140);
          move(420, 230);
        
          check(
            inspect().draft.board === boards[1] &&
            inspect().draft.blocked,
            "Both board sizes can be guided"
          );
        
          check(
            Math.abs(inspect().draft.end[1] + 140 - 200) < 0.001,
            "Lower board also blocks the line"
          );
        
          keyHandlers[0]({ key: "Escape" });
          elements.reset.onclick();
        
          check(
            inspect().scene.boards.length === 2 &&
            inspect().scene.boards.every(b => !b.marks.length),
            "Single scene reset"
          );
        
          return "PASS";
        })()`, c);
        
        console.log(result);

📁 tools/
    📄 knife.js
        --- 파일 내용 시작 ---
        window.WorkshopTools = window.WorkshopTools || {};
        
        WorkshopTools.Knife = class {
          constructor(ctx) {
            this.ctx = ctx;
            this.stroke = null;
            this.hover = null;
          }
        
          activate() {
            this.ctx.say(
              "구두칼: 1칸=판자 1px입니다. 클릭 또는 드래그로 깎으세요. 확대하면 격자가 보입니다."
            );
          }
        
          move(point) {
            if (this.stroke) return;
        
            const board = this.ctx.pick(point, 1.5);
        
            this.hover = board
              ? { board, cell: Wood.cell(board, point) }
              : null;
          }
        
          down(point) {
            if (this.stroke) this.up();
        
            this.move(point);
            if (!this.hover) return;
        
            const source = this.hover.board;
        
            this.stroke = {
              source,
              shown: [source],
              last: point.clone(),
              cells: new Set(),
              stencil: null
            };
        
            this.ctx.setCancel(true);
            this.stamp(point);
          }
        
          drag(point) {
            if (this.stroke) this.stamp(point);
          }
        
          stamp(point) {
            const s = this.stroke;
            const c = this.ctx;
            const delta = point.subtract(s.last);
        
            const steps = Math.max(
              1,
              Math.ceil(
                Math.max(Math.abs(delta.x), Math.abs(delta.y)) * 2
              )
            );
        
            const cells = [];
        
            for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i++) {
              const p = s.last.add(delta.multiply(i / steps));
              const cell = Wood.cell(s.source, p);
              const key = cell.join(",");
        
              if (s.cells.has(key)) continue;
        
              const origin = Wood.cellOrigin(s.source, cell);
              const rect = new paper.Rectangle(
                origin,
                new paper.Size(1, 1)
              );
        
              if (
                !rect.intersects(Wood.bounds(s.source)) ||
                !c.visible(
                  s.source,
                  origin.add([0.5, 0.5]),
                  s.shown
                )
              ) {
                continue;
              }
        
              s.cells.add(key);
              cells.push(cell);
            }
        
            s.last = point.clone();
        
            this.hover = {
              board: s.source,
              cell: Wood.cell(s.source, point)
            };
        
            if (!cells.length) return;
        
            const next = Wood.stencil(s.source, cells);
        
            const stencil = s.stencil
              ? martinez.union(s.stencil, next)
              : next;
        
            const result = Wood.carve(s.source, stencil);
            s.stencil = stencil;
        
            if (!result) return;
        
            c.replace(s.shown, result.pieces, false);
            s.shown = result.pieces;
        
            c.say(
              `구두칼: ${result.removedArea.toFixed(2)}px² 깎았습니다. Esc: 이번 드래그 취소`
            );
          }
        
          up() {
            if (!this.stroke) return;
        
            const last = this.stroke.last;
        
            this.stroke = null;
            this.ctx.geometryChanged();
            this.ctx.setCancel(false);
            this.move(last);
          }
        
          cancel() {
            if (this.stroke) {
              this.ctx.replace(
                this.stroke.shown,
                [this.stroke.source]
              );
            }
        
            this.stroke = null;
            this.hover = null;
            this.ctx.setCancel(false);
            this.ctx.say("이번 구두칼 드래그를 취소했습니다.");
          }
        
          deactivate() {
            this.up();
            this.hover = null;
          }
        
          drawBoard(board) {
            const selected = this.stroke
              ? this.stroke.shown.includes(board)
              : this.hover?.board === board;
        
            if (selected) Wood.grid(board);
          }
        
          drawOverlay() {
            if (!this.hover) return;
        
            const { board, cell } = this.hover;
            const origin = Wood.cellOrigin(board, cell);
        
            const excluded = this.stroke
              ? this.stroke.shown
              : [board];
        
            if (
              !this.ctx.visible(
                board,
                origin.add([0.5, 0.5]),
                excluded
              )
            ) {
              return;
            }
        
            new paper.Path.Rectangle({
              rectangle: new paper.Rectangle(
                origin,
                new paper.Size(1, 1)
              ),
              fillColor: new paper.Color(0.85, 0.15, 0.1, 0.25),
              strokeColor: "#c23d2d",
              strokeWidth: 1 / paper.view.zoom
            });
        
            this.ctx.hud(
              `구두칼 · 1×1px · (${cell[0]}, ${cell[1]})`
            );
          }
        };
        --- 파일 내용 끝 ---

    📄 move.js
        --- 파일 내용 시작 ---
        window.WorkshopTools = window.WorkshopTools || {};
        
        WorkshopTools.Move = class {
          constructor(ctx) {
            this.ctx = ctx;
            this.board = null;
          }
        
          activate() {
            this.ctx.say(
              "판자나 조각을 드래그하세요. Space+드래그는 화면 이동입니다."
            );
          }
        
          down(point) {
            this.board = this.ctx.pick(point);
        
            if (this.board) {
              this.offset = point.subtract([
                this.board.x,
                this.board.y
              ]);
            }
          }
        
          drag(point) {
            if (!this.board) return;
        
            const b = Wood.bounds(this.board);
            const next = point.subtract(this.offset);
        
            this.board.x = Math.max(
              12,
              Math.min(1000 - b.width - 12, next.x)
            );
        
            this.board.y = Math.max(
              65,
              Math.min(600 - b.height - 45, next.y)
            );
          }
        
          up() {
            if (this.board) this.ctx.geometryChanged();
            this.board = null;
          }
        
          deactivate() {
            this.up();
          }
        
          cancel() {
            this.up();
          }
        };
        --- 파일 내용 끝 ---

    📄 pencil.js
        --- 파일 내용 시작 ---
        window.WorkshopTools = window.WorkshopTools || {};
        
        WorkshopTools.Pencil = class {
          constructor(ctx) {
            this.ctx = ctx;
            this.hover = null;
            this.draft = null;
          }
        
          activate() {
            this.ctx.say(
              "변이나 기존 끝점에서 시작하고 내부 점을 이어 찍으세요."
            );
          }
        
          cancel() {
            this.hover = this.draft = null;
            this.ctx.snapper.clear();
            this.ctx.setCancel(false);
          }
        
          deactivate() {
            this.cancel();
          }
        
          idlePoint(point) {
            const c = this.ctx;
            const s = c.snapper;
        
            if (
              this.hover?.kind === "vertex" &&
              this.hover.point.getDistance(point)
                <= s.releasePixels / paper.view.zoom
            ) {
              return this.hover;
            }
        
            const edge = s.update(
              point,
              paper.view.zoom,
              c.visible
            );
        
            if (edge) {
              return { ...edge, kind: "edge" };
            }
        
            let best = null;
        
            for (const board of Wood.sorted(c.scene.boards).reverse()) {
              for (const mark of board.marks) {
                for (const endpoint of mark) {
                  const p = c.world(board, endpoint);
                  const distance = p.getDistance(point);
        
                  if (
                    distance <= c.tolerance() &&
                    (!best || distance < best.distance) &&
                    c.visible(board, p)
                  ) {
                    best = {
                      board,
                      point: p,
                      distance,
                      kind: "vertex"
                    };
                  }
                }
              }
            }
        
            return best;
          }
        
          move(point) {
            if (!this.draft) {
              this.hover = this.idlePoint(point);
              return;
            }
        
            const c = this.ctx;
            const d = this.draft;
            const start = c.world(d.board, d.start);
        
            const result = c.snapper.move(
              d.motion,
              point,
              paper.view.zoom,
              null,
              start
            );
        
            const end = Wood.limit(
              d.board,
              start,
              result.point
            );
        
            d.end = c.local(d.board, end);
            d.motion.point = end.clone();
            d.blocked = result.blocked;
          }
        
          drag(point) {
            this.move(point);
          }
        
          down(point) {
            this.move(point);
        
            const c = this.ctx;
            const s = c.snapper;
        
            if (!this.draft) {
              const h = this.hover;
        
              if (!h) {
                return c.say(
                  "판자의 변 또는 기존 끝점을 클릭하세요."
                );
              }
        
              const start = c.local(h.board, h.point);
              const contacts =
                s.hoverMotion?.board === h.board
                  ? s.hoverMotion.contacts
                  : [];
        
              this.draft = {
                board: h.board,
                start,
                end: [...start],
                blocked: h.blocked || false,
                motion: s.motion(h.board, h.point, contacts)
              };
        
              this.hover = null;
              s.clear();
              c.setCancel(true);
        
              c.say(
                "다음 점을 클릭하면 직선을 확정하고 그 점에서 이어 그립니다. Esc로 끝냅니다."
              );
              return;
            }
        
            const d = this.draft;
            const mark = [d.start, d.end];
        
            if (
              !Wood.contains(d.board, point) &&
              Wood.edge(d.board, point).distance > c.tolerance() &&
              !d.blocked
            ) {
              return c.say("선택한 판자 안쪽을 클릭하세요.");
            }
        
            if (!Wood.validMark(d.board, mark)) {
              return c.say("3단위보다 긴 선을 그려주세요.");
            }
        
            d.board.marks.push(mark.map(p => [...p]));
        
            const next = [...d.end];
        
            this.draft = {
              board: d.board,
              start: next,
              end: [...next],
              motion: d.motion,
              blocked: false
            };
        
            s.clear();
            c.say(
              "선을 확정했습니다. 이어 그리거나 Esc로 연결을 끝내세요."
            );
          }
        
          preview(board) {
            return this.draft?.board === board
              ? [this.draft.start, this.draft.end]
              : null;
          }
        
          drawOverlay() {
            const c = this.ctx;
            const d = this.draft;
            const radius = 4 / paper.view.zoom;
        
            if (d) {
              new paper.Path.Circle({
                center: c.world(d.board, d.start),
                radius,
                strokeColor: "#344b55",
                strokeWidth: 1.5 / paper.view.zoom
              });
        
              new paper.Path.Circle({
                center: c.world(d.board, d.end),
                radius,
                fillColor: d.blocked ? "#ce693c" : "#344b55"
              });
        
              c.hud(
                `${d.board.name} · 클릭: 선 확정 · Esc: 연결 종료`
              );
            } else if (this.hover) {
              new paper.Path.Circle({
                center: this.hover.point,
                radius,
                fillColor: this.hover.blocked
                  ? "#ce693c"
                  : "#486749"
              });
        
              c.hud(
                `${this.hover.board.name} · ${
                  this.hover.kind === "vertex"
                    ? "기존 끝점"
                    : "선택한 변"
                }`
              );
            }
          }
        };
        --- 파일 내용 끝 ---

    📄 saw.js
        --- 파일 내용 시작 ---
        window.WorkshopTools = window.WorkshopTools || {};
        
        WorkshopTools.Saw = class {
          constructor(ctx) {
            this.ctx = ctx;
          }
        
          activate() {
            this.ctx.say(
              "확정한 연필선을 클릭하면 선 길이만큼 홈을 팝니다."
            );
          }
        
          down(point) {
            const c = this.ctx;
        
            for (const board of Wood.sorted(c.scene.boards).reverse()) {
              if (!c.visible(board, point)) continue;
        
              const index = board.marks.findIndex(mark => {
                const line = Wood.line(board, mark);
        
                const hit =
                  line.getNearestPoint(point).getDistance(point)
                    <= c.tolerance();
        
                line.remove();
                return hit;
              });
        
              if (index < 0) continue;
        
              const result = Wood.cut(board, index, 6);
        
              if (!result) {
                return c.say(
                  "이 선에서는 더 파낼 재료가 없습니다."
                );
              }
        
              c.replace([board], result.pieces);
        
              c.say(
                result.pieces.length > 1
                  ? `${result.pieces.length}개 조각으로 나뉘었습니다.`
                  : "선 길이만큼 홈을 팠습니다."
              );
              return;
            }
        
            c.say("확정한 선의 보이는 부분을 클릭하세요.");
          }
        };

📄 viewpoint.js
    --- 파일 내용 시작 ---
    /* Paper.js View 기반 확대·축소와 화면 이동. */
    window.WorkshopViewport = class {
      constructor(box, output, redraw) {
        this.box = box;
        this.output = output;
        this.redraw = redraw;
        this.factor = 1;
        this.focus = new paper.Point(500, 300);
        this.panning = null;
        this.ready = false;
    
        new ResizeObserver(() => this.resize()).observe(box);
        this.resize();
      }
    
      resize() {
        const center = this.ready
          ? paper.view.center.clone()
          : new paper.Point(500, 300);
    
        paper.view.viewSize = new paper.Size(
          this.box.clientWidth,
          this.box.clientHeight
        );
    
        this.fitZoom = Math.min(
          this.box.clientWidth / 1000,
          this.box.clientHeight / 600
        );
    
        paper.view.zoom = this.fitZoom * this.factor;
        paper.view.center = center;
        this.ready = true;
        this.update();
      }
    
      update() {
        this.output.textContent =
          `${Math.round(this.factor * 100)}%`;
    
        this.redraw();
      }
    
      zoom(multiplier) {
        const anchor = this.focus.clone();
        const screen = paper.view.projectToView(anchor);
    
        this.factor = Math.max(
          1,
          Math.min(32, this.factor * multiplier)
        );
    
        paper.view.zoom = this.fitZoom * this.factor;
    
        paper.view.center = paper.view.center.add(
          anchor.subtract(paper.view.viewToProject(screen))
        );
    
        this.update();
      }
    
      fit() {
        this.factor = 1;
        this.focus = new paper.Point(500, 300);
        paper.view.zoom = this.fitZoom;
        paper.view.center = this.focus;
        this.update();
      }
    
      panStart(point) {
        this.panning = {
          screen: paper.view.projectToView(point),
          center: paper.view.center.clone()
        };
      }
    
      panMove(point) {
        if (!this.panning) return;
    
        const delta = paper.view.projectToView(point)
          .subtract(this.panning.screen)
          .divide(paper.view.zoom);
    
        paper.view.center =
          this.panning.center.subtract(delta);
    
        this.redraw();
      }
    
      panEnd() {
        this.panning = null;
      }
    };
    --- 파일 내용 끝 ---

📄 wood.js
    --- 파일 내용 시작 ---
    /* 판자 도형, 톱 절단, 픽셀 격자와 구두칼 차집합. */
    window.Wood = {
      nextId: 1,
    
      create(x, y, w, h, name = "판자") {
        return {
          id: this.nextId++,
          name,
          x,
          y,
          contours: [[[0, 0], [w, 0], [w, h], [0, h]]],
          marks: [],
          gridX: 0,
          gridY: 0
        };
      },
    
      shape(board) {
        const paths = board.contours.map(points => new paper.Path({
          segments: points.map(([x, y]) => [board.x + x, board.y + y]),
          closed: true,
          insert: false
        }));
    
        return paths.length === 1
          ? paths[0]
          : new paper.CompoundPath({ children: paths, insert: false });
      },
    
      line(board, mark) {
        return new paper.Path({
          segments: mark.map(([x, y]) => [board.x + x, board.y + y]),
          insert: false
        });
      },
    
      area(board) {
        const path = this.shape(board);
        const area = Math.abs(path.area);
        path.remove();
        return area;
      },
    
      bounds(board) {
        const path = this.shape(board);
        const bounds = path.bounds.clone();
        path.remove();
        return bounds;
      },
    
      sorted(boards) {
        return [...boards].sort(
          (a, b) => this.area(b) - this.area(a) || a.id - b.id
        );
      },
    
      contains(board, point) {
        const path = this.shape(board);
        const inside = path.contains(point);
        path.remove();
        return inside;
      },
    
      edge(board, point) {
        const path = this.shape(board);
        const nearest = path.getNearestPoint(point);
    
        const result = {
          point: nearest.clone(),
          distance: nearest.getDistance(point)
        };
    
        path.remove();
        return result;
      },
    
      intervals(path, a, b) {
        const delta = b.subtract(a);
        const length2 = delta.dot(delta);
        if (length2 < 0.000001) return [];
    
        const line = new paper.Path({
          segments: [a, b],
          insert: false
        });
    
        const values = [
          0,
          1,
          ...path.getIntersections(line).map(hit =>
            hit.point.subtract(a).dot(delta) / length2
          )
        ]
          .filter(t => t >= 0 && t <= 1)
          .sort((x, y) => x - y);
    
        const cuts = values.filter(
          (t, i) => !i || t - values[i - 1] > 0.000001
        );
    
        const intervals = [];
    
        for (let i = 0; i < cuts.length - 1; i++) {
          const left = cuts[i];
          const right = cuts[i + 1];
          const mid = a.add(delta.multiply((left + right) / 2));
    
          if (
            path.contains(mid) ||
            path.getNearestPoint(mid).getDistance(mid) < 0.001
          ) {
            intervals.push([left, right]);
          }
        }
    
        line.remove();
        return intervals;
      },
    
      limit(board, a, b) {
        const path = this.shape(board);
        const spans = this.intervals(path, a, b);
        let end = 0;
    
        for (const [left, right] of spans) {
          if (left > end + 0.000001) break;
          end = right;
        }
    
        path.remove();
        return a.add(b.subtract(a).multiply(end));
      },
    
      validMark(board, mark) {
        if (mark.length !== 2) return false;
    
        const [a, b] = mark.map(([x, y]) =>
          new paper.Point(board.x + x, board.y + y)
        );
    
        return (
          a.getDistance(b) > 3 &&
          (
            this.contains(board, a) ||
            this.edge(board, a).distance < 0.05
          ) &&
          this.limit(board, a, b).getDistance(b) < 0.01
        );
      },
    
      draw(board, preview = null) {
        const path = this.shape(board);
    
        path.fillColor = "#cb945a";
        path.strokeColor = "#72502f";
    
        // 확대했을 때 외곽선이 1픽셀짜리 구멍을 덮지 않도록 합니다.
        path.strokeWidth = Math.min(2, 1.5 / paper.view.zoom);
    
        paper.project.activeLayer.addChild(path);
    
        const mask = path.clone({ insert: false });
        mask.clipMask = true;
    
        const contents = new paper.Group([mask]);
        const b = path.bounds;
    
        for (let y = b.top + 12; y < b.bottom; y += 13) {
          contents.addChild(new paper.Path.Line({
            from: [b.left, y],
            to: [b.right, y + 3],
            strokeColor: "#a97845",
            strokeWidth: 1
          }));
        }
    
        for (const mark of [
          ...board.marks,
          ...(preview ? [preview] : [])
        ]) {
          const line = this.line(board, mark);
          line.strokeColor = "#34322e";
          line.strokeWidth = 2;
          line.opacity = mark === preview ? 0.35 : 1;
          contents.addChild(line);
        }
      },
    
      cut(board, index, width = 6) {
        const mark = board.marks[index];
    
        if (!mark || !this.validMark(board, mark) || width <= 0) {
          return null;
        }
    
        const [a, b] = mark.map(([x, y]) =>
          new paper.Point(board.x + x, board.y + y)
        );
    
        const direction = b.subtract(a).normalize();
        const normal = new paper.Point(
          -direction.y,
          direction.x
        ).multiply(width / 2);
    
        const cutter = new paper.Path({
          closed: true,
          insert: false,
          segments: [
            a.add(normal),
            b.add(normal),
            b.subtract(normal),
            a.subtract(normal)
          ]
        });
    
        const source = this.shape(board);
        const result = source.subtract(cutter, { insert: false });
    
        const removedArea =
          Math.abs(source.area) - Math.abs(result.area);
    
        if (removedArea < 0.00001) {
          [source, cutter, result].forEach(p => p.remove());
          return null;
        }
    
        result.reorient(true, true);
    
        const pieces = this.parts(board, result, index);
    
        [source, cutter, result].forEach(p => p.remove());
    
        return { pieces, removedArea };
      },
    
      parts(board, result, skip = -1) {
        const paths = result instanceof paper.CompoundPath
          ? result.children
          : [result];
    
        const groups = paths
          .filter(p => p.clockwise && Math.abs(p.area) > 0.00001)
          .map(outer => ({ outer, holes: [] }));
    
        for (const hole of paths.filter(p => !p.clockwise)) {
          const owners = groups
            .filter(g => g.outer.contains(hole.getInteriorPoint()))
            .sort((a, b) =>
              Math.abs(a.outer.area) - Math.abs(b.outer.area)
            );
    
          if (owners.length) owners[0].holes.push(hole);
        }
    
        const pieces = groups.map(({ outer, holes }) => {
          const origin = outer.bounds.topLeft;
    
          const piece = {
            id: this.nextId++,
            name: board.name,
            x: origin.x,
            y: origin.y,
    
            // 조각의 원점이 바뀌어도 기존 픽셀 격자를 유지합니다.
            gridX: board.x + (board.gridX || 0) - origin.x,
            gridY: board.y + (board.gridY || 0) - origin.y,
    
            contours: [outer, ...holes].map(p =>
              p.segments.map(s => [
                s.point.x - origin.x,
                s.point.y - origin.y
              ])
            ),
            marks: []
          };
    
          const shape = this.shape(piece);
    
          board.marks.forEach((other, i) => {
            if (i === skip) return;
    
            const [start, end] = other.map(([x, y]) =>
              new paper.Point(board.x + x, board.y + y)
            );
    
            for (const [left, right] of this.intervals(shape, start, end)) {
              const points = [left, right].map(t =>
                start.add(end.subtract(start).multiply(t))
              );
    
              if (points[0].getDistance(points[1]) > 3) {
                piece.marks.push(points.map(p => [
                  p.x - origin.x,
                  p.y - origin.y
                ]));
              }
            }
          });
    
          shape.remove();
          return piece;
        });
    
        return pieces;
      },
    
      cell(board, point) {
        return [
          Math.floor(
            point.x - board.x - (board.gridX || 0) + 1e-9
          ),
          Math.floor(
            point.y - board.y - (board.gridY || 0) + 1e-9
          )
        ];
      },
    
      cellOrigin(board, cell) {
        return new paper.Point(
          board.x + (board.gridX || 0) + cell[0],
          board.y + (board.gridY || 0) + cell[1]
        );
      },
    
      // 선택한 픽셀 사각형들을 하나의 제거 영역으로 합칩니다.
      stencil(board, cells) {
        let shapes = cells.map(([x, y]) => {
          x += board.gridX || 0;
          y += board.gridY || 0;
    
          return [[[
            [x, y],
            [x + 1, y],
            [x + 1, y + 1],
            [x, y + 1],
            [x, y]
          ]]];
        });
    
        while (shapes.length > 1) {
          const next = [];
    
          for (let i = 0; i < shapes.length; i += 2) {
            next.push(
              i + 1 < shapes.length
                ? martinez.union(shapes[i], shapes[i + 1])
                : shapes[i]
            );
          }
    
          shapes = next;
        }
    
        return shapes[0] || null;
      },
    
      carve(board, stencil) {
        if (!stencil) return null;
    
        const subject = board.contours.map(ring => [
          ...ring,
          ring[0]
        ]);
    
        const geometry = martinez.diff(subject, stencil) || [];
    
        const children = geometry.flatMap(polygon =>
          polygon.map((ring, index) => {
            const path = new paper.Path({
              insert: false,
              closed: true,
              segments: ring.slice(0, -1).map(([x, y]) => [
                board.x + x,
                board.y + y
              ])
            });
    
            path.clockwise = index === 0;
            return path;
          })
        );
    
        const result = new paper.CompoundPath({
          children,
          insert: false
        });
    
        const removedArea =
          this.area(board) - Math.abs(result.area);
    
        const pieces = this.parts(board, result);
        result.remove();
    
        return removedArea > 0.00000001
          ? { pieces, removedArea }
          : null;
      },
    
      grid(board) {
        if (paper.view.zoom < 6) return;
    
        const bounds = this.bounds(board).intersect(
          paper.view.bounds
        );
    
        if (bounds.width <= 0 || bounds.height <= 0) return;
    
        const origin = this.cellOrigin(board, [0, 0]);
        const mask = this.shape(board);
        mask.clipMask = true;
    
        const group = new paper.Group([mask]);
    
        for (
          let x = Math.ceil(bounds.left - origin.x);
          x <= bounds.right - origin.x;
          x++
        ) {
          group.addChild(new paper.Path.Line({
            from: [origin.x + x, bounds.top],
            to: [origin.x + x, bounds.bottom],
            strokeColor: "#735d43",
            strokeWidth: 0.5 / paper.view.zoom,
            opacity: 0.45
          }));
        }
    
        for (
          let y = Math.ceil(bounds.top - origin.y);
          y <= bounds.bottom - origin.y;
          y++
        ) {
          group.addChild(new paper.Path.Line({
            from: [bounds.left, origin.y + y],
            to: [bounds.right, origin.y + y],
            strokeColor: "#735d43",
            strokeWidth: 0.5 / paper.view.zoom,
            opacity: 0.45
          }));
        }
      }
    };
    --- 파일 내용 끝 ---
